blocks.html: An 18-day Tanzania safari with a Zanzibar beach holiday

blocks.orig: Suitable to include the Wildebeest Migration
blocks.html: A trip that can take in the Wildebeest Migration

blocks.orig: This 18 days Tanzania Safari & Zanzibar tour takes you from outstanding wildlife parks to tropical white sand beaches. Visit the Serengeti, home to the largest wildebeest migration, or the Ngorongoro Crater, a natural wonder with unsurpassed wildlife. Unwind after your safari on the beautiful beaches of Zanzibar Island, where you can snorkel and dive in the crystal clear waters of the Indian Ocean.
blocks.html: On this 18-day Tanzania Safari & Zanzibar trip you travel from remarkable wildlife parks to white, tropical beaches. You can explore the Serengeti, where the largest wildebeest migration takes place, or the Ngorongoro Crater, a natural wonder whose wildlife is unsurpassed. Once the safari is over, you wind down on the beautiful beaches of Zanzibar Island and snorkel or dive in the crystal-clear water of the Indian Ocean.

blocks.orig: This private safari offers you the flexibility to travel at your own pace, exactly the way you like it. You will have a private safari vehicle and guide.
blocks.html: Because this is a private safari, you are free to set your own pace and travel just the way you prefer. A guide and a safari vehicle are reserved for you alone.

blocks.orig: Many travelers ask us when the best time is to visit Tanzania. The answer is … there is not one right answer. It depends on what you want to see, where you want to go, your budget and interests. Please find a comprehensive guide on when is the best time to visit Tanzania here.
blocks.html: A question we hear a lot is when Tanzania is best visited. The honest answer: there is no single right one. It comes down to what you hope to see, where you would like to go, and your interests and budget. You will find an in-depth guide on the best time to visit Tanzania on this page.

blocks.orig: Our safaris in Tanzania offer an opportunity to explore the country’s incredible wildlife and stunning landscapes. We specialize in private safaris, which means you have a 4×4 Landcruiser or jeep all to yourselves. You have the flexibility to decide when the safari starts and ends, and our experienced guides can help you make that decision on the day of your adventure. Whether you want to witness the animals at their most active during sunrise and sunset when temperatures are pleasant, or if you fancy ending the day by the pool, it’s entirely up to you. Tanzania’s diverse wildlife is active at various times of the day, so you’ll have plenty of opportunities to spot the animals in action.
blocks.html: With our safaris in Tanzania you get the chance to discover the country’s remarkable wildlife and beautiful landscapes. Private safaris are our speciality: the 4×4 Landcruiser or jeep is reserved for your group only. You choose when each safari day begins and finishes, and our experienced guides are happy to help you decide on the day itself. Whether you’d like to watch the animals at their liveliest around sunrise and sunset, when temperatures are pleasant, or would rather finish the afternoon at the pool, it’s your call. Tanzania’s varied wildlife is active at different times of day, so there will be many chances to see the animals in action.

Our team works closely with you to ensure that your entire trip is tailor-made to your satisfaction. If you plan your Tanzania adventure with us, you’re doing more than booking a trip; you’re setting out on an experience built around you. We begin by getting to know your wishes and preferences, and we won’t rest until every part of the journey matches what you have in mind. blocks.orig: Absolutely, Tanzania is renowned as one of the prime destinations to encounter the Big Five. These magnificent creatures—lion, leopard, elephant, rhinoceros, and buffalo—can be observed in their natural habitats, making Tanzania a preferred choice for wildlife enthusiasts.
blocks.html: Yes, Tanzania is well known as one of the top destinations for meeting the Big Five. Lion, leopard, elephant, rhinoceros and buffalo—these impressive animals can all be watched in their natural habitats, which is why so many wildlife lovers pick Tanzania.

blocks.orig: Absolutely, Tanzania is a safe and welcoming destination for travelers. The country offers a hospitable environment, especially in tourist areas like Arusha, and you can explore its beautiful landscapes and wildlife with confidence. Local people are friendly, and safety measures, such as keeping an eye on your belongings, are always advisable, just as you would in any other part of the world. Tanzania’s natural beauty and the warmth of its people make it a fantastic place to visit.
blocks.html: Yes, Tanzania is a welcoming and safe country to travel in. It is a hospitable place, particularly in tourist areas such as Arusha, so you can discover its wildlife and beautiful scenery with confidence. People are friendly, and it is always sensible to take basic precautions, like watching your belongings, as you would anywhere else in the world. The warmth of Tanzania’s people and its natural beauty make it a fantastic country to visit.

blocks.orig: As you walk out of Kilimanjaro International Airport, your personal Your Tanzania Trip guide greets you with a big smile: 'Karibu Tanzania - welcome to Tanzania!' The guide takes you straight to your hotel, where you can relax and take in the African atmosphere. The next day your guide takes you on an exclusive, private safari that allows you to travel at your own pace. Enjoy the luxury of your own safari jeep and take the liberty to stop and watch the animals as long as you like!
blocks.html: When you step out of Kilimanjaro International Airport, your own Your Tanzania Trip guide is there to meet you with a broad smile: 'Karibu Tanzania - welcome to Tanzania!' Your guide drives you directly to the hotel, so you can unwind and soak up the African atmosphere. The following day you set off on an exclusive private safari where you set the pace yourself. You have your own safari jeep, and you are free to stop and watch the animals for as long as you wish!

blocks.orig: Today is a wonderful relaxing day, that you can spend in whatever way you like. Choose to spend the whole day at the lodge to enjoy the excellent service, sip on refreshing drinks, lounge near the pool, and just engulf yourself in the African vibes surrounding you. Or get to know Arusha through some interesting activities - go for example on a city tour, explore the outskirts of the city by mountain bike, or score your first souvenirs at an exhilarating Maasai market…
blocks.html: Today is a lovely, relaxed day to fill however you wish. You could stay at the lodge all day, enjoy the excellent service, sip a cool drink by the pool and simply soak up the African atmosphere around you. Or discover Arusha through some interesting activities - take a city tour, for example, cycle through the outskirts of town on a mountain bike, or pick up your first souvenirs at a lively Maasai market…

blocks.orig: Today you will go for your first actual game drive, in Arusha National Park! This park close to Arusha is known for its abundance of tropical birds, the presence of the black and white Colobus monkey and some rare albino baboons. You will probably spot the Colobus monkey and some rare bird species such as the gorgeous Silvery Cheeked Hornbill, and, if you are very lucky, even an albino. The park also has a lake, a few craters, waterfalls, mountains, and beautiful grassy planes.
blocks.html: Your first real game drive takes place today, in Arusha National Park! Close to Arusha, this park is famous for its many tropical birds, the black and white Colobus monkey and a few rare albino baboons. Chances are you will see the Colobus monkey and rare birds like the stunning Silvery Cheeked Hornbill, and, with a lot of luck, even an albino. You will also find a lake, several craters, waterfalls, mountains and lovely grassy plains in the park.

blocks.orig: Today you can relax at your hotel to enjoy the friendly service, or go out and about through a range of activities! You can for example visit the beautiful Mount Meru waterfalls. A short hike leads you there, after which you can take a refreshing swim in the cold water beneath the waterfall. Have your lunch in these quiet surroundings amidst singing birds and meandering water and try and spot the amazing Colobus monkey or the Silvery Cheeked Hornbill on your way back!
blocks.html: Today you are free to unwind at your hotel and enjoy the friendly service, or to go out and pick from a wide choice of activities! One option is a visit to the beautiful Mount Meru waterfalls. You reach them on a short hike, and afterwards you can cool off with a swim in the cold water at the foot of the falls. Eat your lunch in this peaceful setting, with birdsong and flowing water around you, and keep an eye out for the remarkable Colobus monkey or the Silvery Cheeked Hornbill on the way back!

blocks.orig: Tarangire National Park is well known for its big groups of elephants and the huge amount of giant baobab trees. These trees can live for hundreds of years and are actually a source of water for elephants in the dry season as they have a special technique to draw water from them. Besides, the Tarangire River is the only source of water in the dry season, which is why in this season in Tarangire you can see groups of up to 250 elephants next to many more animals!
blocks.html: Tarangire National Park is famous for its large elephant herds and its great number of giant baobab trees. These trees can reach an age of hundreds of years, and in the dry season elephants actually use them as a water source, thanks to a special technique for getting the water out. On top of that, the Tarangire River is the only water source during the dry season, so at that time of year you can see herds of up to 250 elephants in Tarangire, alongside many other animals!

blocks.orig: Serengeti National Park is widely known as the place to go on safari, mainly because of the Great Migration that passes through here. The enormous, stampeding herds are impressive, as are the vast number of predators that live here: over four thousand lions, over 200 cheetahs, a thousand leopards, 3500 hyenas, and hundreds of wild dogs! And of course, plenty of other beautiful animals, which your guide will be delighted to search for together with you. Are you ready for this?
blocks.html: Serengeti National Park has a worldwide reputation as the place for a safari, largely thanks to the Great Migration moving through it. The huge herds on the run are impressive, and so is the number of predators living here: more than four thousand lions, more than 200 cheetahs, a thousand leopards, 3500 hyenas and hundreds of wild dogs! There are, of course, many other beautiful animals too, and your guide will be glad to look for them with you. Are you ready?

blocks.orig: The famous Ngorongoro Crater is one of Africa's seven natural wonders. The crater was formed two million years ago when a vast volcano erupted. The fertile lava has created a unique ecosystem, now home to the highest concentration of animals found anywhere in Africa! Once in the crater, thousands of animals such as lions, zebras, buffalos and black rhinos surround you, and the views are astounding – you won’t know where to look!
blocks.html: The well-known Ngorongoro Crater counts as one of Africa's seven natural wonders. It came into being two million years ago, when a huge volcano erupted. The fertile lava gave rise to a unique ecosystem, which now holds the highest concentration of animals anywhere in Africa! Inside the crater you are surrounded by thousands of animals, including lions, zebras, buffalos and black rhinos, and the views are stunning – you won’t know which way to look!

blocks.orig: Today you fly to the spice island of Zanzibar. Our guide picks you up at the airport and takes you to your hotel. Over the next few days, you can discover white sandy beaches, crystal-clear turquoise waters and vibrant coral reefs. Into culture? Then head to Stone Town and dive into the history of this fascinating little town. Food lovers can also visit the spice plantations and discover the diverse flavours of the delicious local cuisine. A tropical paradise awaits you!
blocks.html: Today you take a flight to Zanzibar, the spice island. At the airport our guide meets you and drives you to your hotel. In the days ahead you can explore white sandy beaches, clear turquoise water and colourful coral reefs. Interested in culture? Make your way to Stone Town and immerse yourself in the history of this intriguing little town. If you love food, you can visit the spice plantations and get to know the varied flavours of the tasty local cuisine. A tropical paradise is waiting for you!

blocks.orig: Ultimate paradise is here: gorgeous, tropical Zanzibar! The clear blue waters of the Indian Ocean and the palm-fringed, white sandy beaches are almost too beautiful to be true. Buy your coconut drink fresh on the beach, spend hours sunbathing or swimming, and taste the delicious Zanzibari food. In the mood for something active? Then explore the beach, ocean, and island through a range of activities! We highly recommend the Safari Blue Cruise or a tour of Stone Town.
blocks.html: Welcome to real paradise: beautiful, tropical Zanzibar! With the clear blue Indian Ocean and white sandy beaches lined with palms, it seems almost too good to be true. Pick up a fresh coconut drink on the beach, sunbathe or swim for hours, and sample the tasty Zanzibari food. Feeling active? Discover the beach, the ocean and the island with a variety of activities! We can highly recommend the Safari Blue Cruise or a Stone Town tour.

blocks.orig: The last day! Depending on your flight time, you can relax on the beach or explore the island just a little bit more. Then, make your way to Zanzibar International Airport in time for your flight home. Having second thoughts? It's also possible to extend your holiday to another paradise island, such as Mnemba, Pemba, or Mafia!
blocks.html: Your final day! Depending on when your flight leaves, you can unwind on the beach or see a little more of the island. After that, you head to Zanzibar International Airport in good time for your flight home. Not quite ready to leave? You can also add another paradise island to your holiday, such as Mnemba, Pemba or Mafia!
